selection_note: Sites were chosen by topical diversity and bounded manifest size after an exploratory run on four different sites. No action outcomes from the sites below were inspected before this protocol.
success_criterion: On each held-out site, the action model must beat both its paired alternative action and a separately fitted state-only model in weighted error, with at least 70 percent paired-action wins. A missing coverage threshold or either site failing is an overall failure.
promotion: none; generated websites and one-step 16x16 features cannot establish real desktop, safety, autonomous execution, or Jev parity
